items.title: This week's publish board, 16 to 20 November
items.detail: Start on the Ideas tab: four checked ideas each for Monday, Wednesday and Friday, and the off-day options for Tuesday and Thursday. Saturday offers the weekly good news in two formats, with its stories found on Thursday 19 November. Tick each step as you do it; every tick is saved at once, and the next session copies it onto the piece.

items.title: Pick the week of 16 November
items.detail: The Ideas tab for 16 to 20 November is live: four checked ideas a day for Monday, Wednesday and Friday, written onto the pieces, and off-day options for Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday. Researched with web search only: Drive and Firecrawl were not connected, so the Cold Ideas & Inspo folder was not read.
